ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا تِلْمِيذَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am a pupil (boy).
   B. I am a pupil (girl).
   C. I am from Kenya.
   D. My name is Ahmad.

2. Which ending shows that you are speaking to a boy? (1 mark)
   A. -na
   B. -ii
   C. -ka
   D. -ki

3. How is the Arabic word جَدٌّ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ʿamma
   B. ukht
   C. jadd
   D. bint

4. What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا بَيْتِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. The cat is under the bed.
   B. This is my house.
   C. The book is on the table.
   D. The lamp is above the table.

5. How is the Arabic word كِتَابٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. qalam
   B. naafidha
   C. misbaah
   D. kitaab

6. Which Arabic sentence means "The pen is in the bag." (1 mark)
   A. الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ
   B. الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ
   C. الْقِطَّةُ تَحْتَ السَّرِيرِ
   D. الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ

7. Which Arabic sentence means "Today is Thursday." (1 mark)
   A. فِي الْأُسْبُوعِ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ
   B. أَلْعَبُ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ
   C. الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ
   D. أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ

8. What does the Arabic word قِفْ (qif) mean? (1 mark)
   A. stand up
   B. close your eyes
   C. touch your nose
   D. write

9. How is the Arabic word حَلِيبٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. bataatis
   B. faakiha
   C. bayd
   D. haliib

10. What does the Arabic sentence آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I eat bread.
   B. I drink water.
   C. I like juice.
   D. I like bananas.

11. What does the Arabic word فَمٌ (fam) mean? (1 mark)
   A. face
   B. mouth
   C. tongue
   D. hair

12. What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ يَدِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I smell with my nose.
   B. This is my hand.
   C. I hear with my ear.
   D. I see with my eye.

13. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I smell with my nose.
   B. I speak with my mouth.
   C. I see with my eye.
   D. I hear with my ear.

14. What does the Arabic word مُمْطِرٌ (mumtir) mean? (1 mark)
   A. sun
   B. cloudy
   C. weather
   D. rainy

15. What does the Arabic sentence الْمَاءُ نَظِيفٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is cold.
   B. The weather is rainy.
   C. The water is clean.
   D. The weather is hot.

16. How do you read the syllable مِ? (1 mark)
   A. da
   B. buu
   C. mi
   D. nu

17. Which sound does the Arabic letter ث make? (1 mark)
   A. kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
   B. d as in dog
   C. j as in jug
   D. th as in think

18. What is the name of the Arabic letter ذ? (1 mark)
   A. daal
   B. laam
   C. thaa
   D. dhaal

19. What does the Arabic sentence أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My brother is small.
   B. My sister is beautiful.
   C. My grandfather is old (big in age).
   D. Hello, Ahmad.

20. How do you read the shadda in the word jad-dun? (1 mark)
   A. The letter daal is said twice
   B. The letter is silent
   C. The vowel is long
   D. The word is a question

21. Which Arabic word means "plate"? (1 mark)
   A. غُرْفَةٌ
   B. سِكِّينٌ
   C. مَطْبَخٌ
   D. صَحْنٌ

22. Which Arabic word means "lamp"? (1 mark)
   A. كُرْسِيٌّ
   B. خِزَانَةٌ
   C. غُرْفَةٌ
   D. مِصْبَاحٌ

23. Which Arabic word means "food"? (1 mark)
   A. طَعَامٌ
   B. بَالُونٌ
   C. تَفَضَّلْ
   D. شَمْعَةٌ

24. Which Arabic sentence means "A gift for Amina." (1 mark)
   A. هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ
   B. عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ
   C. فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ
   D. هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ

25. Which Arabic word means "big"? (1 mark)
   A. الْخَمِيسُ
   B. تَفَضَّلْ
   C. دَجَاجٌ
   D. كَبِيرٌ

26. Which Arabic sentence means "My body is strong." (1 mark)
   A. لِي يَدَانِ
   B. لِي عَيْنَانِ
   C. جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ
   D. هَذَا جِسْمِي

27. How is the Arabic word شَعْرٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. wajh
   B. ʿayn
   C. udhun
   D. shaʿr

28. What is the name of the Arabic letter س? (1 mark)
   A. qaaf
   B. siin
   C. Daad
   D. zaay

29. Which Arabic word means "room"? (1 mark)
   A. قَلَمٌ
   B. غُرْفَةٌ
   C. كُوبٌ
   D. نَافِذَةٌ

30. What does the Arabic word نَافِذَةٌ (naafidha) mean? (1 mark)
   A. door
   B. knife
   C. window
   D. bathroom

31. Which day ends with taa marbuta (ة)? (1 mark)
   A. al-khamiis
   B. al-jumuʿa
   C. al-ahad
   D. as-sabt

32. What does the Arabic word أُسْبُوعٌ (usbuuʿ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Wednesday
   B. Monday
   C. week
   D. yesterday

33. What is a dictation? (1 mark)
   A. You draw a picture
   B. The teacher says a word and you write it
   C. You sing a song
   D. You copy from the board only

34. What does ʿindii hadiyya mean? (1 mark)
   A. We dance.
   B. I drink juice.
   C. I have a gift.
   D. I like the party.

35. Which Arabic word means "cake"? (1 mark)
   A. كَعْكَةٌ
   B. عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ
   C. أُغْنِيَةٌ
   D. رَقْصٌ

36. Which Arabic word means "apples"? (1 mark)
   A. رِجْلٌ
   B. جَدَّةٌ
   C. تُفَّاحٌ
   D. صَدِيقٌ

37. What does the Arabic word مَطَرٌ (matar) mean? (1 mark)
   A. sunny
   B. rain
   C. weather
   D. wind

38. What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ غُرْفَتِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like my house.
   B. In the room there is a bed.
   C. This is my room.
   D. In the kitchen there is a table.

39. Which Arabic sentence means "In the kitchen there is a table." (1 mark)
   A. فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ
   B. هَذِهِ غُرْفَتِي
   C. فِي الْغُرْفَةِ سَرِيرٌ
   D. أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي

40. What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْغُرْفَةِ سَرِيرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the kitchen there is a table.
   B. In the room there is a bed.
   C. This is my room.
   D. I like my house.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into English: akhii Sagiir (2 marks)

42. Write five words about a celebration in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

43. Translate into English: hal tuhibbu l-mawz? (2 marks)

44. Write four weather words in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

45. Translate into English: uhibbu l-mawza (2 marks)

46. Translate into English: ummii tatbukhu T-taʿaam (2 marks)

47. Say why food is important for human life and name two foods grown in Kenya. (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: haadhaa raʾsii (2 marks)

49. Translate into English: fawqa t-taawilati baaluun (2 marks)

50. Translate into English: ʿalaa t-taawilati kaʿka (2 marks)

51. Say where the pen is if it is in the bag. Write the sentence in English letters and translate it. (3 marks) (3 marks)

52. Explain why untidy handwriting can be a problem in Arabic. (2 marks) (2 marks)

53. Translate into English: akhii yalʿabu (2 marks)

54. Copy and translate the sentence أُحِبُّ الْخُبْزَ. (2 marks) (2 marks)

55. Translate into English: baytii kabiir (2 marks)

56. Translate into English: at-taawilatu Sagiira (2 marks)

57. Translate into English: wal-maTaru mina s-samaa'i (2 marks)

58. Give two reasons why reading is important. (2 marks) (2 marks)

59. Write four parts of the body in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

60. Translate into English: anaa min Kiiniya (2 marks)

61. Write a short conversation of three lines in which one friend asks about a party and the other answers. Use English letters. (3 marks) (3 marks)

62. Read the sentence هَذِهِ أُمِّي and give its meaning. Say which family word it contains. (3 marks) (3 marks)

63. Translate into English: anaa fii S-Saffi r-raabiʿ (2 marks)

64. Describe how a class can make a letter bank. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — I am a pupil (girl).
   أَنَا تِلْمِيذَةٌ (anaa tilmiidha) means: I am a pupil (girl).

2. C — -ka
   The ending -ka is used when speaking to a boy or man, as in kayfa haaluka?

3. C — jadd
   جَدٌّ is read jadd and means grandfather.

4. B — This is my house.
   هَذَا بَيْتِي (haadhaa baytii) means: This is my house.

5. D — kitaab
   كِتَابٌ is read kitaab and means book.

6. A — الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ
   الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ (al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba) means: The pen is in the bag.

7. C — الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ
   الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ (al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis) means: Today is Thursday.

8. A — stand up
   قِفْ (qif) means stand up.

9. D — haliib
   حَلِيبٌ is read haliib and means milk.

10. A — I eat bread.
   آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ (aakulu l-khubza) means: I eat bread.

11. B — mouth
   فَمٌ (fam) means mouth.

12. B — This is my hand.
   هَذِهِ يَدِي (haadhihi yadii) means: This is my hand.

13. C — I see with my eye.
   أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي (anaa araa biʿaynii) means: I see with my eye.

14. D — rainy
   مُمْطِرٌ (mumtir) means rainy.

15. C — The water is clean.
   الْمَاءُ نَظِيفٌ (al-maa'u nadhiif) means: The water is clean.

16. C — mi
   مِ is read mi.

17. D — th as in think
   The letter ث makes the sound th as in think.

18. D — dhaal
   The letter ذ is called dhaal.

19. B — My sister is beautiful.
   أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ (ukhtii jamiila) means: My sister is beautiful.

20. A — The letter daal is said twice
   A shadda doubles the letter, so jadd has two d sounds.

21. D — صَحْنٌ
   صَحْنٌ (sahn) means plate.

22. D — مِصْبَاحٌ
   مِصْبَاحٌ (misbaah) means lamp.

23. A — طَعَامٌ
   طَعَامٌ (taʿaam) means food.

24. D — هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ
   هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ (hadiyya li-Aminata) means: A gift for Amina.

25. D — كَبِيرٌ
   كَبِيرٌ (kabiir) means big.

26. C — جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ
   جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ (jismii qawiyy) means: My body is strong.

27. D — shaʿr
   شَعْرٌ is read shaʿr and means hair.

28. B — siin
   The letter س is called siin.

29. B — غُرْفَةٌ
   غُرْفَةٌ (ghurfa) means room.

30. C — window
   نَافِذَةٌ (naafidha) means window.

31. B — al-jumuʿa
   الجمعة ends with ة.

32. C — week
   أُسْبُوعٌ (usbuuʿ) means week.

33. B — The teacher says a word and you write it
   In a dictation you listen and write what you hear.

34. C — I have a gift.
   ʿindii means I have and hadiyya means gift.

35. A — كَعْكَةٌ
   كَعْكَةٌ (kaʿka) means cake.

36. C — تُفَّاحٌ
   تُفَّاحٌ (tuffaah) means apples.

37. B — rain
   مَطَرٌ (matar) means rain.

38. C — This is my room.
   هَذِهِ غُرْفَتِي (haadhihi ghurfatii) means: This is my room.

39. A — فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ
   فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ (fii l-matbakhi taawila) means: In the kitchen there is a table.

40. B — In the room there is a bed.
   فِي الْغُرْفَةِ سَرِيرٌ (fii l-ghurfati sariir) means: In the room there is a bed.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: My brother is small.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example ʿiid (festival), hafla (party), hadiyya (gift), baaluun (balloon), kaʿka (cake).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Do you like bananas?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example shams (sun), matar (rain), riih (wind), sahaab (clouds).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like bananas.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: My mother cooks the food.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Food gives energy to grow, learn and stay healthy. Examples are maize and bananas.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the importance and 1 mark each for two foods.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my head.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Above the table there is a balloon.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: On the table there is a cake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba. The pen is in the bag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the item, 1 mark for the position word fii, 1 mark for the translation.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Letters that differ only by dots may look the same, so the reader may read the wrong word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for dots and 1 mark for the wrong reading.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: My brother plays.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: uhibbu l-khubza. I like bread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a correct copy or sounds and 1 mark for the translation.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: My house is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: The table is small.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: And the rain is from the sky.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: It helps us to learn new words and information, and it gives us enjoyment.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

59. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example raʾs (head), ʿayn (eye), fam (mouth), yad (hand).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am from Kenya.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

61. (3 marks)
   Answer: A: hal ʿindaka hafla? B: naʿam, ʿindii hafla. A: mabruuk!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the question, 1 mark for the answer and 1 mark for a suitable closing wish.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: haadhihi ummii. This is my mother. It contains umm (mother).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for reading, 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for the family word.

63. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am in Grade 4.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

64. (3 marks)
   Answer: Give each group some letters; write each letter and its name on a card with a picture or word that begins with it; arrange the cards in order in the class portfolio.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for writing cards, 1 mark for adding names or words and 1 mark for arranging them.
